rationale: Pinned upstream unconditionally sets no-new-privileges and blocks container-only sudo. A separate builder-only package copy permits sudo only with the trusted CLI environment JUMPSERVE_LAB_SANDBOX_SUDO=1. Container user matches worker UID:GID so 0600 file-tool readback succeeds. Original package bytes remain unchanged; default behavior retains no-new-privileges. No host execution or credentials added.
